app.name: Asabunko
app.subtitle: A calm reader for manga, comics, and light novels.
app.localizedDescription:
Asabunko reads manga, comics, and light novels with a warm dark look and a paper look. Import CBZ, CBR, CB7, and CBT files, archives, and folders of images from Files. Read from the right to the left, from the left to the right, or in one vertical column, and continue where you stopped.

The next versions add EPUB and PDF, OPDS servers, and the source lists of LNReader, Aidoku, Paperback, and Suwayomi. The app comes with no sources. You add your own lists, and you are responsible for them.

Your books stay on your device.
